title: muscarella helenae
intro: Muscarella helenae, commonly known as the Helenae Spiranthes or Green Flag Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Muscarella helenae include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, relieving respiratory issues like asthma, and as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing pain and swelling. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
